blocks.html: Look-at the thermometer. Note down the number it says. Check your current character's weight in your equipment interface. You must equalise both numbers. If you weigh more than the number: subtract the number from the thermometer from your character's weight to get the result number. For example: if the thermometer says 20 and you weigh 30 kg, you would need 10 kg. If you weigh less than the number: subtract your character's weight from the number from to get the result number.

blocks.html: Make whatever arrangements necessary to battle the level 117 Balance Elemental that can use all three combat styles, and lowers your combat stats (except for Necromancy). You can leave the area to get supplies, but always bring your lit sapphire lantern. Don't forget to bring at least two combat styles for the tormented demon fight, unless using Necromancy. The Balance Elemental drains combat stats during the fight, so be sure to bring at least one full super restore.
